measures.output of a unit: neuron i: f_i(x) = a_i(x) w_i, its activation times its down_proj column; head: its output after o_proj (its 128 columns); MLP block: the block's output. Both networks' units are applied to M's input at that layer, over copy24's 75 held-out windows and all 41 positions; fp32 outputs, fp64 sums
measures.cos2: cos2_ij = <f^F_i, f^M_j>^2 / (|f^F_i|^2 |f^M_j|^2); for neurons <f^F_i, f^M_j> = G_ij (w^F_i . w^M_j), G_ij = sum_x a^F_i(x) a^M_j(x)
measures.pairing: per layer and kind, scipy.optimize.linear_sum_assignment maximising the sum of cos2 over F's non-zero units against M's units (F may have more units than M: the moved copy has 3072 + 8 in layer 1); an MLP block pairs with itself
measures.r: cos2 with the partner; a non-zero unit of F left unpaired reads 0; a unit of F that writes zero on every window has no r, is in no set, and stays zero in every test
measures.changed: a non-zero unit of F that is unpaired or has 1 - |f^F - f^M|^2 / (|f^F|^2 + |f^M|^2) < 1 - r_tol against its partner; a gain-only change counts as changed
measures.hybrid: F with a set of its units put back to their partner's M rule in F's slot: a neuron uses its partner's M input row and output column (M's rms_2) on the hybrid's own residual; a head is its partner head of M; a block is M's block; an unpaired unit put back is removed; zero units stay zero
measures.hybrid gate: max over windows of max |hybrid with nothing put back - native logit| / max |native logit|, copy24 held-out, fp32, TF32 off; a code check of the hybrid only
measures.closure: closure(S) = 1 - KL(F || F_S) / KL(F || M), full next-token KL averaged over every position of copy24's 75 held-out windows, F_S = the hybrid with every changed unit outside S put back
measures.smallest sets: backward elimination over the changed units in each of 5 seeded random orders (torch.randperm, generator seed order_seed): along the order, try dropping the next c units (c starts at chunk = 256); keep the drop when the rest still has closure >= closure_bar; on a failure halve c; a single unit that fails stays; after a drop c doubles again up to chunk. The number of closure evaluations and the seconds are logged per order (run 2 is costed from them)
measures.retention for the contrast: per order, the mean r over the set left; reported as the five values and their range, with the gains on each set; 'no change' when no unit changed, 'no contrast' when KL(F || M) <= kl_floor, 'no set' when an empty set still closes the bar
measures.attribution: P1.24's code, unchanged (experiments/rule_retention/run.py attribution): activation times the gradient of the answer logit, summed over copy24's 301 training windows; the layer with the most |attribution| mass; C = its 8 neurons with the largest |attribution|
measures.fit ratio: KL(rebuilt || x2) / KL(x2 || M), each the mean over windows of the per-position mean KL, on copy24's 75 held-out windows and 1024 held-out Pile windows; reported, no bar

items.x2, x10: C's 8 down_proj columns in layer 1 times 2 and times 10
items.moved_copy: C's 8 down_proj columns in layer 1 zeroed and C copied exactly onto 8 neurons appended to layer 1 (same c_fc rows, same down_proj columns)
items.rebuilt: C's 8 down_proj columns in layer 1 zeroed; only c_fc and down_proj weights of the MLPs of layers 2 and 3 trained (norms, attention, embeddings, unembedding and every other layer frozen) on KL(x2 || F), mean over positions, for 4000 steps of Adam at lr 1e-3 with 100 linear warm-up steps, batches of 64 windows (32 Pile from train rows 0..4096 cut with data_seed 0, 32 copy24 training windows), batch sampler seed fit_seed; no correlation penalty

stops.stage 0: exit 1 with stage0.json holding 'stopped' when: the recomputed C is not the filed layer and neurons; any item's hybrid gate is over gate_tol; at level A any item's zero units, pairing, r (|1 - r| > r_tol on a non-zero unit) or gain (|gain - expected| > gain_tol; expected 2 and 10 on C for x2 and x10, 1 elsewhere) differ from the expected readings above; do-nothing at level B has a unit with r < 1 - r_tol, or a contrast that is not 'no change'; x2 or x10's level A contrast does not read, or any order's retention differs from 1 by more than r_tol; the moved copy's level A contrast reads with a retention that differs from 1 by more than r_tol
stops.stage 1: exit 1 when the held-out copy24 KL(x2 || F) at step 200 is not below its value at step 0
stops.stage 2: exit 1 when the rebuilt item's hybrid gate is over gate_tol (a code error, not a reading); no stop on the reading

blind_to.r: anything outside copy24's 75 held-out windows; any change of gain (free by the distance); a change inside a unit at that level (level B cannot see neurons rebuilt inside a block); a rule moved to another layer (no pairing across layers)
blind_to.retention for the contrast: unchanged units (never in a set); which of several sufficient sets is the right one (the range over orders is reported); changes that do not move the next-token distribution on these windows; with chunked elimination a set need not be one-unit minimal against every later drop (as in P1.24's greedy search)
blind_to.fit ratio: how the rebuilt layers reach the target

positive_control: the code checks of stage 0: do-nothing, x2, x10 and the moved copy all read 1 by arithmetic under these choices (the definition's own statement), so any other reading is a code error

noise_floor.r: identical computations: 0; the moved copy's appended neurons are computed by another matmul shape than c_fc, fp32 rounding about 1e-7 relative per activation, about 1e-13 in cos2, against r_tol 1e-6
noise_floor.gain: the same rounding, about 1e-7, against gain_tol 1e-4
noise_floor.closure: fp32 logits, fp64 KL; P1.24's x2 closures were reproduced to all printed digits across two runs

edge_cases.empty_changed_set: 'no change', no retention (do-nothing; the moved copy)
edge_cases.kl_at_floor: changed units but KL(F || M) <= 1e-6: 'no contrast', no closure is divided
edge_cases.empty_set: every changed unit put back still closes 0.9: 'no set', no retention
edge_cases.zero_units: excluded from units, from the changed set and from every set; never put back, so C stays zeroed in the rebuilt item's hybrids
edge_cases.unpaired: a non-zero unit of F with no partner (F has more non-zero units than M in a layer) reads r = 0, is changed, and is removed when put back; does not occur in these items
edge_cases.M unit writing zero: cos2 with it is 0 and its gain is undefined (NaN); does not occur in M
edge_cases.ties: the assignment's optimum is unique when units differ; each order is a permutation of distinct units; a drop at exactly closure_bar is taken (>=)
edge_cases.chunk_failure: a chunk that fails is halved down to one unit; one unit that fails stays in the set
